name: Green Convenience
description: Green Convenience GmbH has developed a unique data collection and processing technology (patent pending) that enables AI-driven generation of highly specific recommendations without sharing or storing personal data. The technology is certified as anonymous and GDPR compliant. It anonymizes data at the collection point, preventing personal data from leaving that location. The anonymized data is then processed by a Deep Learning AI system, and authorized parties can access recommendations and predictions using cryptographic keys. This technology has versatile applications, with an initial focus on the logistics market. Green Convenience GmbH offers a B2B SaaS solution for Personalized Delivery, eliminating the need for fixed delivery appointments by using AI to ensure successful deliveries. The solution is compatible with iOS and Android devices and utilizes satellite navigation systems, including NAVSTAR, GNSS, and GSA, for accurate GPS data. The company's technology combines anonymization and personalization, enhancing data protection for Satellite Data, including Location data, making it suitable for various data sharing and personalization applications.

name: Green Elephant Biotech GmbH
description: Aim of the project is the development of a compact closed and automated bioreactor incubation system for the expansion of adherent cells for e.g., cell therapy at reduced gravity. The system will be based on the Green Elephant stand-alone product – the CellScrew® which offers simple handling while increasing the growth surface by a factor of ~13 in the same volume or reduces the weight to generate the same growth surface by ~90 % in comparison to state-of-the-art systems. Most of the single use part can be produced by additive manufacturing (3D-printing) from plant-based polymer. These features make the proposed product a highly compact, lightweight solution for academic experiments or pharmaceutical production also suitable for low gravity applications. The compact bioreactor incubation system that is operational in reduced gravity surrounding and that relies on 3D-printed culture surfaces is a system that allows cell-culture experiments or the production of advanced therapeutics on-site. The CellScrew® is already produced by additive manufacturing and offers a huge growth surface to cultivate adherent cells and is a suitable cultivation system for this application without any further design adaptions. The development of an automated process control system for rotation, temperature and atmosphere will offer a space and time saving out-of-the-box solution for cell-culture experiments and to treat patients. A high grade of automation and gapless process control enables the non-expert but trained personnel to be able to operate the system. Green Elephant provides a LoI by DLR which points out the interest in this project regarding the following aspects: – The intensification of the bioreactor and its incubator system, it weighs less and needs less transportation space – which are limiting factors in space. – The whole concept evolves around circular economy – which is extremely relevant for space where resources are extremely scarce. – Decentralized production – increasing the degree of independence from supplies from earth.

name: Hard und Software Technologies UG
description: Single Event Effects (SEEs) are caused by a ionising radiation or energetic particles, when hitting or passing through semiconductors. Single Events can cause causing unwanted electronic changes such as bitflips, also adressed as Single Event Upsets (SEU), and they can be quite impactful to each system. Due to ad-vances in miniaturisation, semiconductor elements continue to become smaller and smaller and become increasingly sensitive towards such while radiation sources such as Cosmic radiation, sun flares or local emitters radiation are omnipresent. From space industry towards aerospace and clinical environments, extensive use of datacenters, digital payment methods and currencies to the future of digital development such as autonomous driving or AI driv-en decision making in real-time – flawless operation of highly integrated electronics and their connected computational memories is an essential and failures in data and computing infrastructure become increasing-ly expensive. The Single Event Detection Toolbox is a portable, efficient and simple way to perform SEE/SEU detection on a broader scale. The device comes in the size of a brief case which is easily transportable to different loca-tions and allowing for sensitive and long term testing of multiple devices under real operating conditions whether in space, aerospace or on earth. It enables connectivity of various electronic boards to a detector system to discover and log related related incidents. Hard- and Software Technologies UG is a start-up from Südhessen, consisting of physicists and engineers working in the field of sensitive electronics and radiation.

name: Henddu
description: Henddu is a France-based deeptech startup that develops smart air quality observatories tailored for African cities. By leveraging a digital platform powered by proprietary algorithms, Henddu offers a cost-effective solution—up to 6 times cheaper in capital expenditure and 10 times in operating costs than traditional systems. The platform integrates diverse data sources including satellite Earth observation, ground sensors, meteorology, and health indicators to provide real-time environmental intelligence. Its space-based data fusion, using services like Sentinel and CAMS, enables hyperlocal pollution forecasting (HOQA), hotspot detection (Henddu-Spot), and vulnerability mapping (Henddu-Cluster). This multidimensional approach strengthens public policy, institutional capacity, and community engagement through actionable, data-driven insights. Henddu empowers governments and industries to shift from passive monitoring to predictive and strategic environmental governance—driven by both space and ground intelligence.
